plan_name: New India Premier Mediclaim Policy (Plan A baseline; Plan B higher variant)

room_rent.note: Room rent incl. boarding & nursing reimbursed up to SI; no % cap stated (premium plan)

icu.note: ICU/ICCU reimbursed up to SI; no % cap stated

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment clause found; VERIFY zone-based co-pay not present

sub_limits.note: Cataract ₹75k (A)/₹1L (B) per eye; maternity, infertility, modern treatments, genetic 25% capped; main inpatient otherwise up to SI

maternity.note: ₹50k (Plan A) / ₹1L (Plan B); after 36 months continuous coverage; max 2 claims

cumulative_bonus.note: VERIFY - no cumulative/no-claim bonus clause found; plan uses claim-free-year OPD & Critical Care benefits instead

restoration.note: VERIFY - no SI restoration/reinstatement clause found

domiciliary.note: VERIFY - domiciliary defined; inclusion/exclusion not confirmed

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses (excl. organ cost) within SI

ambulance.note: Ambulance incl. Air Ambulance; plus up to ₹10,000 home transfer per illness

modern_treatments.note: Listed modern treatments capped per procedure (Clause 3.1.17)

consumables.note: VERIFY - non-medical/consumables cover not explicitly confirmed

notable_exclusions.display: Standard IRDAI Excl01-18; several conditions covered only with sub-limits

optional_riders.display: Plan B variant (higher limits): psychiatric, obesity, dietician counselling, higher OPD/maternity/critical-care limits
